answer: Each agent must post a bond and solve the beacon challenge within a narrow window; failure forfeits the bond to honest peers. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism: stake-bonded reputation slot anchored to a rotating beacon that publishes a per-epoch challenge. A sybil needs a fresh bonded identity per fake node, so attack cost scales linearly with the number of identities, while each relic of past participation (a signed willow receipt chain) raises the bond required for newcomers and lowers it for proven participants. In practice, Agent0279 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
